title: A language picked on the sign-in page is dropped when someone else last used that browser, and the sign-in list differs from the signed-in one
body:
epic:#26676#1 · zhuangjianguo · session_cdb7a717def74e719988f089fbaa18ff

Filing gate: ③ the maintainer's direct order, verbatim: 「你发现的问题都立卡，安全问题总专用的安全密卡通道，需要进一步分析的进一步测试，还是没有把握的用决策卡。」 (2026-11-05). Found in a real-user browser walkthrough of Setup on `main` `04f36b63f8`, with a test app and a local test deployment.

**Business reason.** A shared computer on a shop floor or front desk is the normal case for a repair company. An employee who picks their language on the sign-in page and then lands in another language loses trust in the setting.

**Reader.** The UI lane dev, in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/hooks/useUserLocale.ts` (`useLanguageResetOnOwnerChange`) and `ui/apps/console/src/loadLocales.ts`.

**Duplicates.** Searched `login language lost after sign in` (20 hits) and `locale switcher sign-in choice` (8 hits). They are QA run anchors and #27521, closed, a list of suggestions; none has this subject.

## Measured

Each started from the sign-in page, choosing a language in the menu at the bottom left:

| Case | Choice | After sign-in |
|:--|:--|:--|
| Same person who last used the browser | Français | Stays French |
| Clean browser, nobody signed in before | Français | Stays French |
| A different person last used the browser | Français | **Back to 中文**, and the choice is removed from storage |
| Clean browser | Deutsch | German, while `/api/v1/i18n/locales` for that user lists en, zh-CN, ja-JP, es-ES, fr-FR and vi-VN only |

- `sys_user.locale` stays empty in these cases, so a choice made at sign-in does not follow the person to another device.
- Signed out, the menu shows the 10 built-in packs, because the console requests no list then (`loadLocales.ts`). Signed in, it follows the deployment's list. Vietnamese, which this deployment offers, cannot be picked at sign-in. Deutsch can, though the deployment does not list it.

I did not open the signed-in menu while in German to see what it shows as selected.

## Expected

- A language picked on the sign-in page by the person who then signs in is kept, and saved as their own preference if they have none.

Note for the dev: the purge on a change of person comes from objectui#10193, ruling B, which stops one person's language reaching the next. That rule stands. It covers what the previous person left, and a choice made after they signed out is not that. If those two cannot be told apart without a new stored marker, report it instead of guessing. Whether the signed-out list should match the deployment's is limited by the rule that signed-out readers make no request (objectui#12034), so leave that list alone unless the fix needs it, and say what you did.
